# wayfinder_workspace_cloudaccount (Resource)

CloudAccount represents an account/project/subscription in a cloud provider which Wayfinder should know about

<a id="nestedblock--spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec`

Required:

- `allocation` (Block List, Min: 1, Max: 1) Allocation describes which workspaces can use this cloud account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--allocation))
- `cloud` (String) Cloud defines which cloud provider this account is for
- `identifier` (String) Identifier is the unique identifier for this account with the cloud provider, i.e. AWS account ID, GCP project ID, Azure subscription, etc. Required unless the accountType is managed.

For accountType organization this should be the account ID/subscription ID/project ID to place shared org-wide resources such as DNS root zones, etc. For AWS this must be the same AWS Master Account ID used for OrgIdentifier.

To use the identifier for a CloudAccount, ALWAYS reference Status.Identifier, not this field, as this will be unpopulated and ignored on managed accounts.
- `name` (String) Name is the unique logical name for this cloud account

Optional:

- `account_type` (String) AccountType identifies whether this is an organization account (which can be used by Wayfinder to create managed accounts), a shared account (used directly to build workspace infrastructure), or a managed acccount (created by Wayfinder's account management features)
- `default_region` (String) DefaultRegion is an optional default region to use for API access in this account when no region is specified for the operation. This is used to determine, for example, which region to use to talk to global services such as Route53 in AWS. E.g. eu-west-2, europe-west2, uksouth
- `description` (String) Description is an optional longer human-readable description of this cloud account to help users understand which cloud account to choose.
- `features` (List of String) Features lists the ways in which it is intended for this cloud account to be used. This will allow the relevant set of roles to be determined for this cloud account.
- `identity_cred` (Block List, Max: 1) IdentityCred is a reference to the credential for Wayfinder to identify itself to this cloud provider when using this account.

To use workload identity, specify an empty namespace and name - this will only work if Workload Identity has been configured in the Wayfinder management cluster, this account is in the same cloud provider as the management cluster, and that workload identity is given access to this account) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--identity_cred))
- `naming_rules` (Block List) NamingRules describes for Organization type accounts how to name child accounts based on the plan chosen. Required for account factory functionality to operate for an Organization account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--naming_rules))
- `org_identifier` (String) OrgIdentifier, required only for accountType organization and must be populated with the identifier for the organization - for example, AWS Master Account ID, Azure Tenant ID, GCP Organization ID, etc.

Ignored if accountType is not organization.
- `org_user_roles` (Block List) OrgUserRoles is the set of user roles to make available in child accounts of this org

Ignored if accountType is not organization. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--org_user_roles))
- `parent_account` (Block List, Max: 1) ParentAccount is a reference to another CloudAccount (with account type 'organization') of this cloud account, for managed (required) and shared (optional) accounts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--parent_account))
- `provider_details` (Block List, Max: 1) ProviderDetails provides additional fields which can be used for cloud-provider specific data, such as a GCP billing account ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--provider_details))
- `roles` (Block List) Roles defines the possible ways in which Wayfinder can use this account, along with details of how Wayfinder should identify itself (or provider-specific roles that need to be assumed) to use this account in the specified way. The set of roles required for a cloud account is defined by the enabled features. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--roles))
- `stages` (List of String) Stages lists the stages that this cloudaccount may be used for
- `user_roles` (List of String) UserRoles are the roles which will be available for user access into this cloud account

<a id="nestedblock--spec--provider_details--aws_organization"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.provider_details.aws_organization`

Required:

- `region` (String) Region is the region where control tower is enabled in the master account Required if feature AccountManagement enabled.

Optional:

- `ou_name` (String) OuName is the name of the parent Organizational Unit (OU) to use for provisioning accounts Required if feature AccountManagement enabled.
- `sso_user` (Block List, Max: 1) SsoUser is the user who will be the organisational account owner for all accounts. Required if feature AccountManagement enabled. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--provider_details--aws_organization--sso_user))
- `user_roles` (Map of String) UserRoles contains the ARNs of stacksets to create instances of in each managed account

<a id="nestedblock--spec--provider_details--aws_organization--sso_user"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.provider_details.aws_organization.sso_user`

Required:

- `email` (String) Email is the unique user email address specified for the AWS SSO user Required if feature AccountManagement enabled.

Optional:

- `first_name` (String) FirstName is the firstname(s) field for an AWS SSO user Required if feature AccountManagement enabled.
- `last_name` (String) LastName is the last name of an SSO user Required if feature AccountManagement enabled.

### Nested Schema for `spec.provider_details.azure_subscription`


<a id="nestedblock--spec--provider_details--azure_tenant"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.provider_details.azure_tenant`

Optional:

- `agreement_type` (String) AgreementType defines whether we're building subscriptions in an MCA or Enterprise Agreement backed Azure setup
- `billing_account` (String) BillingAccount is the billing account identifier. Required for both agreement types.

Example (super-catchy, isn't it): aaa111b-abcd-ef01-2345-bcdabc123fed:1234aaab-0100-1234-abcd-abcd0123abcd_2019-05-31
- `billing_profile` (String) BillingProfile defined for an MCA agreement type which billing profile contains the invoice section you wish subscriptions to be created in. Required for MCA.

Example: AW4F-APQW-0AH-ABC
- `contributor_object_id` (String) ContributorObjectID specifies an optional object ID of an Azure AD group, user or service principal to grant Contributor privilege on all created subscriptions.

Example: 8bf96a8f-dcef-abc1-a389-883d6116a5da
- `enrollment_account` (String) EnrollmentAccount defines for an Enterprise Agreement agreement type which enrollment account to create subscriptions within. Required for EA.

Example: 7654321
- `invoice_section` (String) InvoiceSection defines for an MCA agreement type which invoice section to create subscriptions within inside the selected BillingProfile. Required for MCA.

Example: PQRS-ALDS-012-DEF
- `management_group_id` (String) ManagementGroupID specifies an optional ID of an Azure Management Group in which subscriptions created by Wayfinder should be placed.

Example: wf-subscription-mgt-group
- `owner_object_id` (String) OwnerObjectID specifies the Object ID of an Azure AD group, user or service principal to grant Owner privilege on all created subscriptions. This is required to ensure that generated subscriptions are owned by an object controlled by your company.

Example: 8bf96a8f-abcd-ef12-a389-883d6116a5da


<a id="nestedblock--spec--provider_details--gcp_organization"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.provider_details.gcp_organization`

Optional:

- `billing_account` (String) BillingAccountName is the resource name of the billing account associated with the project e.g. '012345-567890-ABCDEF'
- `parent_id` (String) DEPRECATED: Use OrgIdentifier on Spec. This will be ignored if OrgIdentifier is populated on the Spec.
- `parent_type` (String) ParentType is the type of parent this project has Valid types are: "organization", "folder", and "project"

### Nested Schema for `spec.roles`

Required:

- `role` (String) Role is the Wayfinder cloud role that this account can be used for

Optional:

- `assume_provider_role` (String) AssumeProviderRole contains a reference to the identifier that should be assumed by Wayfinder when using this account for this role, i.e. AWS ARN, GCP Service Account, Azure Role, etc.
- `deployed_resource_hash` (String) DeployedResourceHash is a checksum calculated from the role definition when created - This is set by the wf setup roles command which creates the cloud resources for the role - It is used by the controller to indicate if the role setup needs to be repeated
